title: Ensuring Buildings are Constructed with Materials Approved under Existing Regulations
what_it_is: Ensuring Buildings are Constructed with Materials Approved under Existing Regulations

sections.label: Building plan approval and supervision
sections.summary: Qualified Persons must show building materials meet structural safety specifications in plans and supervise construction, including testing concrete and steel.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: First, when submitting building plans for BCA's approval, Qualified Persons (QPs) who are either registered architects or professional engineers must show in their plans that the building materials used meet required specifications for structural safety.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Second, during construction, QPs are required to supervise the building works to ensure that the works are carried out in accordance with the approved plans.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: This includes ensuring that the building materials used, like concrete and steel for structural elements, have been tested by accredited laboratories and meet the required specifications.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Samples are taken from concrete delivered to site, to test the compressive strength, and steel bars used for reinforced concrete are tested for tensile strength.

sections.label: Site audits and occupation permits
sections.summary: BCA audits construction sites and inspects buildings before granting TOP or CSC, requiring clearances from regulatory agencies for fire safety, sanitation, drainage and sewerage.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: BCA also conducts site audits on projects under construction to check that building regulations are adhered to and that all parties carry out their duties as required.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Third, before buildings are occupied, QPs need to apply to BCA for a Temporary Occupation Permit (TOP) or Certificate of Statutory Completion (CSC).

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: BCA conducts site inspections to check that the buildings have been constructed according to the approved plans and that they meet BCA's requirements.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: BCA also requires QPs to obtain the relevant regulatory agencies' clearances for requirements, such as fire safety, sanitation, drainage and sewerage, before TOP or CSC can be granted.
